JANUS_SPIRE2_EVENT_KITTEN_CARD_GAME.page: [b][color=#3EE6B3]A kitten is playing beside your Deck. After rummaging around, it proudly pulls out [gold]{RandomCard}[/gold] and pins it beneath its paw, as though waiting for you to choose.[/color][/b]
Copy [gold]{RandomCard}[/gold] and add it to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
Pay [red]{Gold}[/red] [gold]Gold[/gold] to have the kitten find another card.
[b][color=#3EE6B3]The kitten pushes the first card back into the Deck and eagerly rummages around. A moment later, it pulls out [gold]{RandomCard}[/gold].[/color][/b]
[b][color=#3EE6B3]You take the card the kitten found. It flicks its tail in satisfaction and pounces back into its game.[/color][/b]
